workbook_notes: Source: Regional Epidemiology and Surveillance Unit (RESU), DOH Center for Health Development - CALABARZON.
Source system: Philippine Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (PIDSR) Information System.
Coverage: Antipolo City, Rizal, morbidity weeks 1-53, years 2016-2025.
- Leptospirosis: transcribed directly from the provided table; no printed total row existed in the source, so only the computed TOTAL (SUM formula) is shown.

- Measles-Rubella: source PDF listed years in descending order (2025->2016); reordered here to ascending (2016->2025) for consistency across sheets. Source's own printed TOTAL row is shown beneath the computed TOTAL for verification -- they match.

- Dengue: source PDF listed years ascending already. Week 53 has data only for 2025 (56 cases); other years had no week 53 in the source (left blank, not zero). Source's own printed GRAND TOTAL is shown beneath the computed TOTAL for verification -- they match.
All TOTAL/GRAND TOTAL rows use live =SUM() formulas referencing the weekly data, so they recalculate automatically if any cell is edited.
